evals.prompt: how much traffic did we get last month and where from? we have ga4 and yandex metrika
evals.expected_output: Detects credential paths (GA4 runtime/CLI + Metrika env), reports which are live, pulls period totals from both engines plus GSC if configured, presents one comparison table with the GA4-vs-Metrika caveat (session definition, attribution, bot filtering) instead of silently blending numbers.
assertions: Queries both engines for the period

evals.prompt: покажи поисковые фразы из яндекса за октябрь
evals.expected_output: Runs yandex-metrika.js stats phrases with the period, reports top phrases, checks sample_share and caveats proportions when sampling is on, clusters phrases into topics and maps them to landing pages.

evals.prompt: our visits dropped, is it google or yandex?
evals.expected_output: Runs organic breakdown: Metrika stats sources (organic.yandex vs organic.google split) plus GSC clicks/impressions for the Google side; correlates an engine-specific drop with technical findings rather than a tracking bug; correlates with the Google updates ledger before attributing cause.
assertions: Separates engine issue from tracking issue
